    Real separating weights on modules over a commuting division ring #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.divisionEuler_real_nonpos_of_submodule_tests {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (D : Type u) [DivisionRing D] (M : ModuleCat R) [Module D ↑M] [SMulCommClass R D ↑M] [Module.Finite D ↑M] {I : Type u_1} [Fintype I] (P : I → FiniteProjective R) (a : I → ℝ) (hR : IsEFinite R) (ha : ∀ (N : FGModuleCat R) (i : N.obj ⟶ M), Function.Injective ⇑(ModuleCat.Hom.hom i) → ∑ t : I, a t * ↑(homFinrank k (↑(P t)) N) ≤ 0) :
    ∑ t : I, a t * ↑(Module.finrank D (↑↑(P t) →ₗ[R] ↑M)) ≤ 0

    Real weights nonpositive on finite submodules give the same inequality when Hom dimensions are measured over the commuting division ring.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.divisionEuler_real_nonneg_of_quotient_tests {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (D : Type u) [DivisionRing D] (M : ModuleCat R) [Module D ↑M] [SMulCommClass R D ↑M] [Module.Finite D ↑M] {I : Type u_1} [Fintype I] (P : I → FiniteProjective R) (a : I → ℝ) (hR : IsEFinite R) (ha : ∀ (N : FGModuleCat R) (q : M ⟶ N.obj), Function.Surjective ⇑(ModuleCat.Hom.hom q) → 0 ≤ ∑ t : I, a t * ↑(homFinrank k (↑(P t)) N)) :
    0 ≤ ∑ t : I, a t * ↑(Module.finrank D (↑↑(P t) →ₗ[R] ↑M))

    The quotient tests give the opposite inequality over the division ring.
